description: What desktop/scripts/stage.mjs copies into desktop/staging/. The layout mirrors the production stage of backend/Dockerfile and frontend/Dockerfile; src/staging-manifest.spec.ts fails when a Dockerfile gains a COPY this list does not account for. from is repo-relative (a directory, a file, or a glob in the last segment); to is under staging/; kind is copy (default), backend-deps, help-images, postgres, desktop or vc-runtime. A desktop entry is a desktop-owned file that mirrors no Dockerfile line (it is copied like copy, from desktop/, never into backend/ or frontend/). A vc-runtime entry is staged on Windows only: its files are the Visual C++ runtime DLLs the PostgreSQL binaries import, copied from the build machine's Visual Studio redistributable directory.

entries.mirrors: backend/Dockerfile: COPY --from=builder /app/help ./help (the builder stage copies website/docs/*.md into ./help/)
none: desktop-only, no container runs it; the supervisor loads it into every backend and frontend process with --require (src/supervisor/parent-watch.ts)
none: desktop-only; the window, splash and tray icon on Windows, which loads an .ico from a real file outside the asar (src/shell/icon.ts)
none: the containers use a postgres image; the desktop build ships the native/ directory of the embedded-postgres platform package

none: Windows only; the Visual C++ runtime the PostgreSQL binaries import and their package does not ship, found on the build machine by scripts/lib/vc-runtime.mjs, which also fails the run when anything under postgres/ imports a runtime DLL this list lacks
